limitations: shared source confirmations are not independent agent measurements
within-stratum round bootstrap does not estimate between-process or serving/population uncertainty, round autocorrelation or multiple-comparison correction
provider cost units not independently verified; setup/calibration/acquisition costs excluded
one baseline provider.no-route retained; no retry
free-form review was not blind; no output-quality superiority score
fixed initial profiling packet; later feedback has benchmark and validation, no fresh hints/PMU/level4
no explicit independent token cap; identical profile/time/candidate limits with actual usage retained
